name: CallForEachOffsetPlusBase
signature: void fn_00596A30(uint32_t* out, uint32_t /*stack slot +0x08, unused*/, const uint32_t* begin, uint32_t /*stack slot +0x10, unused*/, const uint32_t* end, OffsetCallback cb, uint32_t base)
summary: For each DWORD in [begin, end), calls cb(*entry + base); then writes (cb, base) to out[0], out[1].
